assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent botanical growth-stage sprite atlas for a gesture-controlled flower artwork. Create ONE atlas image with exactly 6 square cells arranged in an exact equal 3-column by 2-row grid, no borders, no labels. Canvas ratio exactly 3:2, preferably 1536x1024. Subject: a single pink sacred lotus (Nelumbo nucifera), many naturally overlapping pink petals with ivory bases and deep rose tips, delicate longitudinal veins, realistic yellow stamens and a green-yellow seedpod, a slender green stem. Each cell must depict THE SAME specimen at THE SAME fixed 3/4 camera angle, same illumination and same fixed stem/branch position, viewed close-up with exceptional botanical macro realism. Six stages in row-major order: top-left tightly closed bud; top-middle first petals opening slightly; top-right one-third open; bottom-left half-open; bottom-middle almost open; bottom-right fully blooming. Keep growth monotonic. The flower receptacle remains at exactly the same normalized position (50% x, 45% y) within every cell; stem ends at y=90% consistently. Each individual flower is centered within its own cell, with generous 10% empty gutters on all sides so no petals or leaves ever cross cell boundaries. Transparent alpha background everywhere outside the specimen; NO painted checkerboard, NO ground plane, NO drop shadow, NO reflections, NO container, NO text, NO watermark. Natural diffused daylight from upper left, soft ambient occlusion between overlapping petals, fine petal veins, subtle translucence at thin edges, small asymmetric variations; naturally photographed botanical realism, never plastic, waxy, polygonal, flat vector, cartoon, CGI, or excessively sharpened. Sharp entire specimen, consistent depth of field. All six stages must be distinct and aligned; do not vary zoom or camera angle between cells.
